purpose: SEC Section 31 fee rates and FINRA Trading Activity Fee rates for covered equity sales, in force from 2017-01-01 through retrieval on 2026-09-24, plus the rates already adopted for later dates, each row with its primary sources and verbatim quotes. #162's blueprints/us-equities/mover-early-entry/fees.json is not used.
quote_verification: Each quote is a verbatim substring of the retrieved document after removing markup, unescaping entities and collapsing whitespace (retrieved_format says how the text was read); blueprints/us-equities/mover-v3/data-tools/verify_fee_sources.py re-fetches and checks them. The one sec.gov quote could not be byte-checked (verification_note).

sec_section31.unit: US dollars per million dollars of covered sales
sec_section31.applies_to: covered sales (Exchange Act Section 31(b) and (c)); brokers commonly pass the fee through on sell orders
sec_section31.date_basis: charge date: for a covered sale reported from clearing-agency data this is the settlement date, not the trade date (17 CFR 240.31(a)(3)(i)); for other covered sales it is the trade date

date_basis_source.document: 17 CFR 240.31(a)(3), eCFR (Title 17 up to date as of 2026-09-22)
quotes: (3) Charge date means the date on which a covered sale or covered round turn transaction occurs for purposes of determining the liability of a covered SRO pursuant to section 31 of the Act (15 U.S.C. 78ee). The charge date is: (i) The settlement date, with respect to any covered sale (other than a covered sale resulting from the exercise of an option settled by physical delivery or from the maturation of a security future settled by physical delivery) or covered round turn transaction that a covered SRO is required to report to the Commission based on data that the covered SRO receives from a designated clearing agency;
(iv) The trade date, with respect to all other covered sales and covered round turn transactions.

quotes: FINRA is proposing to temporarily pause assessment of the Trading Activity Fee (``TAF'') for three months, for transactions from October 1, 2026 through December 31, 2026.

For transactions during the three-month period of October, November, and December 2026, the TAF rates set forth in Section 1 of Schedule A to the FINRA By-Laws would temporarily be set at $0.00 and monthly invoices would reflect a $0.00 TAF assessment.
FINRA has filed the proposed rule change for immediate effectiveness. The effective date and the implementation date will be the date of filing.
